CREATE TABLE calendar_events (
	slot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	uid VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	href VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	etag VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (slot_id), 
	UNIQUE (uid)
)

CREATE TABLE calendar_jobs (
	slot_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	due_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (slot_id)
)

CREATE TABLE integrations (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	config JSON NOT NULL, 
	secret TEXT, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	error VARCHAR, 
	paused BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	last_success DATETIME, 
	last_reconcile DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE planner_state (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	settings JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_receipts (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(100), 
	token VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	result JSON, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_review_request UNIQUE (user_id, request_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (token)
)

CREATE TABLE grocery_contributions (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	list_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	week VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	requirement JSON NOT NULL, 
	progress JSON NOT NULL, 
	item_id VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_grocery_requirement UNIQUE (list_id, week, "key"), 
	FOREIGN KEY(list_id) REFERENCES shopping_lists (id)
)

CREATE TABLE planner_slots (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	day VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	meal_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	meal_id VARCHAR, 
	cooking_slot_id VARCHAR, 
	servings INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	time VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL, 
	duration INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pinned BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_planner_position UNIQUE (day, meal_type), 
	FOREIGN KEY(meal_id) REFERENCES meals (id)
)

CREATE TABLE recipe_images (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	meal_id VARCHAR, 
	uploaded_by VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(meal_id) REFERENCES meals (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(uploaded_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE recipe_ratings (
	meal_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	value INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (meal_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(meal_id) REFERENCES meals (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE pantry_staples (
	ingredient_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (ingredient_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(ingredient_id) REFERENCES ingredients (id)
)
